checks.method: Read the frozen abstract, definitions, Theorems 1–3 and the complete literal terminal proposition in FinalEighty.lean; compare the quantifiers and antecedents.
checks.observation: The terminal root retains universally quantified intersecting bound 27 as an explicit argument. The manuscript describes the two-star bound separately, permits empty sunflower cores and distinct finite-set members, and does not promote the external I27 theorem to a local kernel proof.

checks.method: Read TwoHighIncidence.lean and independently eliminate q from the two counted inequalities: 9(3m≤14|U|−5q)+5(2m≤9q).
checks.observation: The result is 37m≤126|U|. The Lean statement needs only four-uniform H, both traces of size at least three, and degree caps 14 on U and 9 on U∩V. No sunflower or ground-size hypothesis is concealed; setting |U|=12 yields m≤40 because 37·41=1517>1512.

checks.method: Independently verify the weight pigeonhole argument and inspect how key_heavy and concentrated_impossible use it in ProfileAConcentrated.lean.
checks.observation: A used extension pair has total weight at least nine, so one endpoint has weight at least five. A different heavy pair omitting that endpoint would make the total at least fourteen, contradicting ten. Every used key therefore extends through that same point; five design triples through it give at most five keys, hence at most twenty rows. The argument does not require enumerating extension-pair permutations.
checks.scope: Constructive scope of the extension concentration step

findings.disposition: The manuscript may optionally state this weighted-pair lemma explicitly to make the general contribution easier to reuse; its current argument is sufficient for the stated application.
findings.statement: The common-extension-point argument can be understood independently of canonical design coordinates: nonnegative weights of total at most ten, and a nonempty family of two-element sets each carrying weight at least nine, force a common point of weight at least five. This is a useful reusable structural ingredient already correctly applied in Section 4.3.

content.summary: The frozen question and principal statements correctly distinguish the conditional global bound from the unconditional two-star theorem. The reusable incidence lemma has precisely the combinatorial hypotheses asserted, and the extension-weight step is a valid abstract concentration argument. These contributions are substantial actual-family structure; no numerical-profile or diagnostic argument is being substituted for realizability. Later phases should audit the inherited design and trace inputs and rebuild coverage.
